evidence.excerpt: Fine-tuning foundation models on financial data has a wide range of applications, including identifying event types from news, monitoring risk and compliance language, and answering questions over filings and earnings calls.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The in-domain change is largest for calibration and argmax accuracy.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We compare three training regimes: (1) response-only LoRA, where the supervised response is the label alone; (2) single-adapter reasoning, where reasoning traces from a teacher model are included alongside the labels in the training loss; and (3) dual-adapter composite training, where separate LoRA adapters are trained on traces and labels.
